title: Finally Understand AI in One Map
description:
I built this free tool so you can finally learn AI the easy way.

AI, machine learning, neural networks, deep learning, generative AI. One interactive map shows how they all fit together. They are not separate things. They are nested inside each other, and this shows you exactly how.

- 30 concepts across 5 nested layers
- A free training video for nearly every one
- Plain-English definitions, click any layer
- AI vs Machine Learning vs Deep Learning, side by side
- A 10-question quiz to test yourself

Free interactive guide, Types of AI Explained:
https://app.stationx.net/tools/types-of-ai

Music: "The Asylum" by RizkeyG (CC BY 3.0)
http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

#Shorts #artificialintelligence #machinelearning #deeplearning #learnai
